notes.title: Patchnote 1.1.3
notes.content: - Fixed a bug that prevented the game from progressing after defeating Yamane & March hare.

notes.title: Patchnote 1.1.1
notes.content:
- Dodo quests can now be skipped when certain conditions are met.
- Resolution is now automatically set when launching from SteamDeck.
- Other scenario consistency adjustments.

notes.title: Patchnote 1.1.0
notes.content:
- Multiple save data is now supported!　Now you can repeat your adventure over and over again with your main save data intact. Don't tell Cheshire Cat.
- The Enter key is now fixed as the decision key for those who can't help themselves with keyboard operations. No one uses it as a jump key...?
- One tutorial has been added. Also, I added a "Skip tutorial" item to the config.
- Fixed a strange bug where for some reason my buddy would start shaking when I walked.
- Fixed some other bugs.

notes.title: Patchnote 1.0.9
notes.content:
- The actions of Mr. Penguin and MadHatter have been revised to be more deliberate and elegant.
- Added pre-motion to some long-range enemies.
- Enemies that are close to you in a deathmatch will now start acting later.
- In casual mode, players will now only take 1 damage when they hit a spike. Gentle.
- Some events have been reworked to be more consistent.
- Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patchnote 1.0.8
notes.content:
- For those who made a mistake in setting key configurations and have no choice, we added an option to reset key configurations by pressing "Q+R+U+P" simultaneously at the title screen.
- The enemies that rush at you have been made to calm down a little. Hit detection is now much smaller.
- Fixed a problem with garbled stage titles in Simplified Chinese.
- Fixed other strange bugs.

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.7
notes.content:
- Usada's special move, the Super Rolling Hammer, has been greatly enhanced thanks to his training. Don't tell me it's not usable anymore.
- We have retrained the guts of the orchestra and cleaned up the problem of the BGM disappearing during the game.
- The lever installed in the castle of hearts had a time lag between activation and operation, and was replaced with a new one.
- The save icon is now in the lower right corner of the screen.
- The probability of the lucky drop skill has been increased.
- The shield break is now invincible. Now you don't get countered by Dodo's water stream!

- Some flag management that was not consistent with the storyline has been rearranged.
* The inhabitants of this world have fuzzy memories, so please report to Developer if you find anything else suspicious.

- Various other bug fixes.

notes.title: Patchnote 1.0.6
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where a dodo who was knocked down had been misplaced due to more scripts. You should no longer be there!

- Added "Return to Title" to the config menu.

- Other minor glitches and typo fixes

notes.title: Patchnote 1.0.5
notes.content:
- Tuned behavior to improve the playing experience.
- The player was often slipping off the floor in the air, so we trained Usada and Kotra.
- Usamura-san gave up his tea time and made the signs at various checkpoints movable.
- When the game was over, the nearest bus stop became a possible restart location.
- Enemies that are about to join a boss fight are now automatically dismissed.

- Fixed a bug that made it difficult to see some characters in simplified and traditional Chinese fonts.
- Fixed other minor bugs / Fixed a bug that caused the system to get stuck in certain cases.

notes.title: Patchnote 1.0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Kotoragun now breaks larger shields. 
-- To balance this, the period their shields are broken have been shortened.
[*] Some attack hitbox of certain enemies are now smaller.
[*] Key Config: Keyboard controls can now be changed.
[*] Key Config: You can now change the button mapping for movement/confirm/cancel. In the case you are stuck due to button changes, you may press your keyboard's escape/ESC button to reset everything to default.
[*] Some effects have been adjusted and added.
[/list]

Other bug fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed bug instances of AI not helping in Casual mode.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the exit message and resolution settings were not compatible with CN fonts.
[*]Fixed font related bugs.
[*] Missing parts of some areas have been deleted.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.2
notes.content:
Fixing of production aspects
Correction of undesirable behavior

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.0
notes.content:
Enhanced production
Fixed a mistake in flag management

notes.title: Demo Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39256559/5a957915634032473e86479e64d8b54e5a350874.jpg[/img]
The Steam Game Festival has begun! And with that said, we're pleased to let you know that Alice Escaped! is participating in this event! A demo went live earlier this morning so you can give the game a try. Let us know what you think of the game in the forums. We hope you like what you see!
